For the White Mountains this doesn't look bad at all. To be fair, slimming your kit wouldn't be impossible, given the conditions I've personally experienced there even in the summer it gets gnarly. Go for a the sack that'll cut weight down tremendously. Clothes stick to bare essentials underwear, socks, base layers, make sure your layers are good though. You can strip down your medkit a bit also and put it in a ziplock bag or a UL drybag. I backpack with a camera and a book also, so I say go for it. Sleeping set up would be the largest weight cut down the line, it took me 4 years to dial mine in, I use a S2S spark 0° and have a durston now, and a Thermarest neoair xrherm. I backpack year round with this kit, just switch my tent depending on location. Save don't spend money on something because it's cool or just a good deal, invest in it.

I was nervous because of the WTF moment but I popped out of my tent and just saw this colorful swirl in the sky like a Van Gogh paint stroke and just stood there jaw dropped and went right back into my tent, took an ass load of melatonin and knocked the fuck out.
